notes: 18 units over 19 source ids (s017+s018 fused) and all 28 target ids.

The correlative count works out one-to-one: each אִם takes a written *whether* and the waw takes the *or* standing between them, so rule 14's correlative-pair clause is not engaged and nothing is added.
*yet* on s012 is an ordinary member of rule 14's open list, read off the ASV.

In *they are a rebellious house* the copula goes to the predicate בֵּית (rule 20) and the resumptive pronoun s011 keeps only *they*; the chain is rendered attributively under rule 28. Since the verbs' *will* auxiliaries are futures rather than fronted question auxiliaries, rule 17's אִם provision does not reach them.
